darwin/arm64.set_from: measured 2026-10-13 on the P-06 tree (archive 85.1.2); RSS rows (entries, case_budgets): the highest median, per row, over seven macos-latest (macos-26-arm64) runs of the Perf gates (macos) job on 2026-10-24 under go1.27.3, each run's own reading the median of nine through the reaper: runs 40126431364 (job 120968759111, 9392bc12), 40128808970 (job 120975905457, d34f308b), 40129385436 (job 120977636340, b46e7983), 40130432262 (job 120980799149, 5412da25), 40130933466 (job 120982296926, efd9d1ef), 40132141210 (job 120985922052, 2a588b9a) and 40132781426 (job 120987866745, PR #95 head 32cacffd, the failure that prompted this). The seven are the lane-g/linux-rss (PR #93) heads and the PR #95 head; none differs from main 323e4075 in anything the release binary builds: they differ in test files, test/perf/budgets.json, internal/budget/budgets_gen.go, two fuzz seeds, internal/fault/fault_on.go (built only under the rashomonfault tag) and, on 32cacffd, a separate module pgraph/ that nothing imports; 9392bc12's rss_test.go predates the nine-readings and TestRES28p_ changes and logs at :389 and :428 instead of :433 and :472, with the same measurement. The reference rows above read lower than the runner: it reads 0.3 to 1.0 MiB higher on every entry (recap.pending 6.06 against 6.75 to 6.98, recap.stop 7.06 against 7.81 to 7.95), and hook.400B, hook.40KB and post.1MiB read above their RES-28 lines, so a row cannot be taken from this repository's Apple M3. gate.go gates a platform whose maps are non-empty only on the rows in them, so all eight entries and all ten cases carry a row here; hook.1MiB, hook.4MiB, hook.8MiB, post.40KB, post.540B, post.4MiB and post.8MiB read at or below RES-28's line on the runner, and their rows here are still the highest runner median, not the line. p95 equals p50, as on linux/amd64 (information only). Within a run the hook 1, 4 and 8 MiB readings carry an occasional outlier (hook.4MiB as low as 15.70, hook.8MiB as low as 23.89, in one or two of nine; hook.1MiB as high as 10.17), but no run's median left the band across the seven (hook.1MiB 9.19 to 9.86, hook.4MiB 19.52 to 19.70, hook.8MiB 31.78 to 31.95), so no row sits on a mode; a median that did land on the low mode reads under its row, which no gate fails

linux/amd64.set_from: RSS rows (entries, case_budgets): the median of nine readings through the reaper in one run, the Perf gates (linux) job of run 40147955591 (job 121033244967, PR #93 head 4f1f479c, ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04 image 20261012.334.1, go1.27.3, 2026-10-25), the first run under the harness controls: THP disabled for the harness and its children (the harness logged the sysfs setting as [always] madvise never, so the runner was at always), every measured child under GOMAXPROCS=1 and with GODEBUG set to gcstoptheworld=2. The gated figure is the serialized 4 KiB-page peak. It is one run, the only one that carries 4f1f479c (no other PR head does), so each row is that run's median, not a highest median over several runs; the nine readings per row were each one cluster (widest: hook.1MiB 6.91 to 7.21, hook.4MiB 13.54 to 13.79, hook.8MiB 21.74 to 22.02), so no row sits on a mode and none is bimodal. Medians in MiB: hook.400B 4.71, hook.40KB 4.96, hook.1MiB 7.00, hook.4MiB 13.68, hook.8MiB 21.93, post.540B 4.71, post.40KB 4.71, post.1MiB 6.33, post.4MiB 12.96, post.8MiB 20.96; hook.bash_short 4.71, hook.edit_50k 4.83, post.bash_short 4.71, post.edit_314k 5.33, recap.stop 6.33, recap.pending 5.21, probe.start 4.58, probe.end 4.71. These replace the rows measured before the controls (8.14 to 10.51 on the small entries and cases, hook.4MiB 19.05, hook.8MiB 27.35, post.4MiB 16.86, post.8MiB 24.58), which read 3 MiB or more higher on THP at always with a concurrent collector, and which post.edit_314k (8.24) and recap.pending (8.54) had set on the low mode of a bimodal pair. The earlier rows are withdrawn. This repository's reference Linux VM reads lower than the runner (about 4.7 for hook.400B, 22.0 for hook.8MiB under the controls), so a row cannot be taken from any other machine; the next run of this job on a further head should be added and the highest median taken. benchmarks: best of three, -benchtime 20x, from run 39876043270's bench-linux artifact on 323e4075 under go1.27.3, cross-checked on a second linux/amd64 machine within 0.1 percent on 31 of 40 rows, and within 5 percent on all of them

parallel.basis: per-process rule (RES-30, ruling 2026-10-13): largest pair peak at most 1.25x the median of 25 solo pairs, both measured in the same run. Restated from measurement on the reference machine with GOMAXPROCS unchanged: largest 1.08x to 1.21x over six runs with nine solo pairs, 1.10x to 1.19x over eleven runs with 25 (4.02 to 4.31 MiB against solo medians of 3.61 to 3.69 MiB), burst median 1.02x to 1.05x; GOMAXPROCS(1) in hook and post measured 1.03x to 1.09x over twenty runs and was rejected. No tolerance on the reference machine; macos-latest unmeasured, so a CI runner gets the platform tolerance on the ratio until it is measured
